I’ve had the same experience for about 2 years, the most significant being when they hung up on my late mum. They would constantly delay appointments which accelerated her death because she couldn’t get the care she deserved. The g.p.c needs to deal with this practice and hire new receptionists. They make already vulnerable people feel like their life is worth nothing. It seems like they get a kick out of it, it’s not helpful at all. They need to learn what their position is in that Gp; just receptionists, nothing special. As harsh as it sounds, it is true and their behaviour needs to be checked. Although I am aware this is common to a lot of patients that ring in, her tone towards me felt discriminatory. She spoke to me as if I didn’t understand English and I felt like I was looked down upon. If this kind of behaviour continues, I will get my sister to file a discrimination claim on this GP.
